reviews.reason: The key work is finding one equation compatible with both source and target and simultaneously preserving Cohen–Macaulayness while cutting fibre dimension. The double-fibre/stabilizer comparison is not supplied by prime avoidance alone; H2 is supported.
reviews.core_assessment: Identify the stabilizer dimension with the double fibre quotient and use d_2>d_1 to choose a hypersurface avoiding every minimal prime of the Cohen–Macaulay fibre. Show the chosen slice preserves the required Cohen–Macaulay map and lowers the identity-fibre dimension by exactly one.
